name: c2c
description: Creator to Catalyst (c2c): migrate a Zoho Creator app (.ds export plus data) to its own Zoho Catalyst project. Gated by a read-only doctor that requires the official Catalyst plugin (skills, MCP connector) and the Catalyst CLI. Dry run by default, resumable, stores no customer data.

metadata.note: dependencies is resolved by Claude Code only. Cross-marketplace resolution is [UNVERIFIED]. c2c doctor checks the prerequisite on every host regardless.
